cli.help:
GasaCLI commands
  gasa --version         Show version and build information
  gasa [--no-browser]    Open the terminal shell and local dashboard
  gasa doctor [--json]   Show local coding CLI readiness
  gasa setup             Review onboarding and install choices
  gasa config            Show or change local configuration
  gasa prompts list      List prompt roles, source and path
  gasa skills            Discover and manage local skills
  gasa brain             Connect and search a local Markdown vault
  gasa permissions       Inspect local permission policy
  gasa run|runs|resume   Manage local orchestration runs
  gasa backup|restore    Manage local backups
  gasa web open          Start the local dashboard
  gasa reset|uninstall   Review and remove local GasaCLI data
  gasa help | --help     Show this help
  --no-browser           Suppress automatic browser launches
  --no-onboarding        Skip first-run onboarding
  --plain                Use line-oriented input instead of the terminal UI
  Free-form model chat and Cloud sync are not connected.
  web.mode auto          Open the dashboard at startup
  web.mode manual        Open the dashboard only with /web open
  web.mode always        Background service is not implemented; auto is used with a warning
